introHtml: Poly propylene reusable straws offer a lightweight, durable alternative to single-use plastic. Unlike glass or metal, these straws are flexible enough for safety while maintaining rigidity for easy drinking. Ideal for schools, daycare centers, or family-friendly events where breakage is a concern. Custom imprint your logo on each straw or the drawstring pouch for a branded takeaway that promotes sustainability without sacrificing practicality.
